_comment: Hardware classes of the trajectory (POL/Porto) timing profiles; same schema
The trajectory timing jobs export JOBLIGHT_TIMING_HARDWARE_SPEC=<this file>.
The first POL timing table (jobs 22579613/14, node n152) ran on AMD EPYC 7313; every
later method must be timed on the same CPU model to share that table, so the class
is fixed to it (was 'allocated'). A node of another model fails before timing;
submit with TIMING_SBATCH_ARGS (e.g. a --constraint or --nodelist) to get one.

cpu_1core.slurm_hint: a base node with AMD EPYC 7313 (e.g. n152); pass TIMING_SBATCH_ARGS

cpu_postgres_2core.slurm_hint: a base node with AMD EPYC 7313 (e.g. n152); pass TIMING_SBATCH_ARGS

cpu_fullnode_exclusive.slurm_hint: scheduler-selected exclusive base node; exact CPU model is fixed and recorded after allocation
